theorems.name: Submission.anyrad_gc_hausdorff_restrict_le_weight
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (O Γ : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen O → V.weight O < ⊤ → Γ ⊆ O → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, 1 ≤ V.mult x) → (∀ y ∈ Γ, ∃ c s₀ : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < s₀ ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < s₀ → ENNReal.ofReal (c * s ^ n) ≤ V.weight (closedBall y s)) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict Γ ≤ V.weight
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
